conceptSheet:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: professional logo exploration sheet for RollbackWitness, a developer tool that investigates whether old code can read data retained from newer releases.
Primary request: three distinct clever, immediately readable logo symbol proposals, matching an existing restrained light UI. The core metaphor is "the code turns back, the data stays put". A return arrow around a single stationary retained record; evidence and rollback combined, not a generic refresh button.
Composition: wide 3:2 sheet on solid cool white #f7f8fa, three generous equal columns with each single symbol centered, then the same wordmark RollbackWitness below each. Below each wordmark one short label only, exactly "Retained record", "Witness loop", "Evidence path". Crisp 2D flat vector-style graphic design, deliberate optical balance, excellent whitespace, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D.
Column 1: a clear counterclockwise return arrow around a small upright retained record with one short line; chunky simple geometry, distinct from a circular refresh icon.
Column 2: an open counterclockwise loop with an arrowhead combined with an eye's single circular pupil, an abstract witness inspecting a fixed point; clean, no literal human eye lashes.
Column 3: a right-angle return path with a left arrowhead and two round endpoint nodes, a traceable evidence relationship, almost an abstract R. Do not use checkmarks.
Colors: ONLY blue #1683f8, charcoal #20232b, pale gray #eceef2 and background #f7f8fa. All three wordmarks charcoal, compact modern neutral sans serif like Inter or Segoe UI with medium weight, exactly "RollbackWitness". No shields, padlocks, mascots, robot heads, sparkles, scales of justice, medical motifs, stock network clouds, multicolor nodes, fake UI, decorative labels, watermark. Each mark must plausibly work at 24px. This is concept exploration, not a final full UI.
signatureIllustration:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: signature transparent illustration for RollbackWitness, a precise developer investigation tool.
Primary request: a sophisticated quiet editorial 3D paper-and-frosted-acrylic illustration of "the code turns back; the data stays put". ONE compact coherent object, isolated on genuine transparency. No text.
Scene: a pale blue open circular return-arrow track curves around a small stationary stack of three translucent rectangular data records. The end of the arrow points clearly left, suggesting rollback. A thin dark blue evidence line runs from the stack to one small round inspection lens in front, with a single blue center. One record is lifted very slightly to be inspected. The stack is obviously retained data, not a financial coin or a shipping package. Minimal and semantically legible; only 3 major elements: return arrow, record stack, inspection lens.
Style: beautifully art-directed small-scale isometric paper sculpture, restrained satin surfaces, soft ambient contact shadows only, precise chamfered edges, translucent ice-blue acrylic with frosted white paper surfaces, clear object hierarchy, excellent silhouette. NOT playful cartoon, not glassmorphism UI, not an app mockup. Blue #1683f8 is the sole strong chromatic accent; charcoal #20232b, cool white #f7f8fa and very pale blue #eff6ff for the rest. Maintain crisp edge readability when composited onto #f7f8fa. Front three-quarter orthographic view. Wide 3:2 framing, centered with at least 12% transparent padding on all sides.
Constraints: no letters, words, numbers, logos, checks, shields, locks, sparkles, gears, robots, humans, red or green safety claims, floating miscellaneous nodes, decorative orbital particles, ground plane or background. Genuinely transparent background. The implication is inspection, never automatic repair or guaranteed safety.
